newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Best Wide delays final results.
newsitem.headline: Best Wide delays final results.

text.p: Garment manufacturing and real estate concern Best Wide Group Ltd said on Friday trading in the company's shares would remain suspended pending the release of its final results announcement.

The company said its results had been delayed because auditors were still awaiting certain evidence from its China joint venture Shijiazhuang Mianerjinhong Textile Co Ltd for the purpose of an audit on the venture, the effect of which, on the auditors' opinion, would have a significant impact on the company's balance sheet and profit and loss accounts for the year ended March 31, it said.
"The Stock Exchange has expressed their concern on the business operation and financial position of the group," the company's chairman Li Chun said.
Li said "presently the group does not have any going concern, cashflow or working capital problem".
Trading in Best Wide shares was suspended on Thursday. They ended unchanged at HK$0.56 each on Wednesday.
